selection: One fixed configuration per algorithm and identical TF-IDF representation, saved before extension execution. No tuning, early stopping, validation labels or held-out fitting.
comparison: 4/class uses the exact existing demonstration IDs. Full means the entire prepared pilot training split (10000 SST-2 and 4886 TREC), not every original source training example; it is a separately labeled unequal-data reference.
preprocessing: Shared existing core word (1,2) and char_wb (3,5) TF-IDF, max 60000 and 80000 features, sublinear TF, float64. Vocabulary and IDF fit selected training rows only; sparse CSR throughout. No SVD, dense conversion, feature selection or text truncation beyond frozen prepared data.
parameter_rationale: Fixed C=1 logistic regression and 200-tree random forest match existing native reference choices. Fixed 100-tree depth-3 boosting configurations match the numerical supplement, without validation tuning. This is an exploratory comparison, not an optimized text-classification leaderboard.
